_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit as needed. config.json is what ISHA actually loads (it is gitignored so your personal settings/API keys never get bundled back into the shared project). All paths in this file are relative to the project root - do not put drive letters or absolute paths here.

llama_cpp.comment: n_threads: null = auto-detect from host CPU. n_gpu_layers: 0 = CPU only (safest/most portable across host PCs); raise this on a PC with a capable GPU for speed.

ollama.comment: Only used if 'preferred' or fallback resolves to ollama and an Ollama server is already running on the host PC. Not required for offline llama.cpp operation.

voice.comment: Both default to off so first-run works with zero extra native audio dependencies. Enable in config.json once pyttsx3 / speech_recognition are installed on the host.

api.comment: Optional. If you want ISHA to be able to fall back to a cloud API instead of / in addition to local models, fill this in and set enabled to true. Never commit real keys - config.json is local-only.
